label: day60
title_zh: 世界啊（在我们最后的时刻）

lines.en: label day60:
Death is a terrifying thing, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 死亡是件可怕的事，不是吗？

lines.en: Recall your closest experience with it.
lines.zh: 回想一下你与它最接近的那次经历。

lines.en: What was it like?
lines.zh: 那是什么感觉？

lines.en: How did it feel?
lines.zh: 你当时体会到了什么？

lines.en: I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: You’re wondering why I’m asking something like this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 你在想，我为什么要问这种问题，对吧？

lines.en: This is supposed to be an escape.
lines.zh: 这里本该是个逃避的地方。

lines.en: That which makes you sad should have no place here.
lines.zh: 让你难过的事，不该在这里有一席之地。

lines.en: And you’re right.
lines.zh: 而你说得对。

lines.en: But, you see...that’s the funny thing about misery.
lines.zh: 但是，你看……这正是痛苦的奇妙之处。

lines.en: It always finds its way in.
lines.zh: 它总能找到路进来。

lines.en: Even through the smallest of cracks.
lines.zh: 哪怕是通过最微小的裂缝。

lines.en: And so we find ourselves, once again, at the edge of everything- trading sadness for solace.
lines.zh: 于是我们又一次站在了一切的边缘——用悲伤换取慰藉。

lines.en: scene sky
Hey...
Do you remember when you jumped?
lines.zh: 你还记得你跳下去的时候吗？

lines.en: Where do you think you landed?
lines.zh: 你觉得你落在了哪里？

lines.en: What do you think happened when you did?
lines.zh: 你觉得你那么做之后，发生了什么？

lines.en: Who would have found you?
lines.zh: 谁会发现你？

lines.en: And what would they have done with your body?
lines.zh: 他们又会怎么处理你的尸体？

lines.en: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: I won’t keep you much longer.
lines.zh: 我不会再耽误你太久。

lines.en: I know you have plans today.
lines.zh: 我知道你今天有安排。

lines.en: But just like last time, there’s something I want you to know first.
lines.zh: 但就像上次一样，有件事我想让你先知道。

lines.en: There are many worlds like this one.
lines.zh: 像这样的世界有很多。

lines.en: In some of them, you will be miserable.
lines.zh: 在其中一些里，你会痛苦不堪。

lines.en: And in others-
lines.zh: 而在另一些里——

lines.en: Nothing will change.
lines.zh: 什么都不会改变。

lines.en: But what if there’s {i}one{/i} world out there where that isn’t the case?
lines.zh: 但万一有那么{i}一个{/i}世界，情况并非如此呢？

lines.en: And what if getting there is as simple as dropping a penny into a wishing well?
lines.zh: 万一去到那里，就像往许愿池里投一枚硬币那么简单呢？

lines.en: Most assuredly, you’d want to visit that place, correct?
lines.zh: 你肯定会想去那个地方看看，对吧？

lines.en: Okay. Well then-
lines.zh: 好吧。那么——

lines.en: scene black
We’re going to count down from ten.
lines.zh: 我们要从十开始倒数。

lines.en: When we’re done, you’ll be in that world.
lines.zh: 数完之后，你就会在那个世界里了。

lines.en: A world where problems only exist as long as you believe they do.
lines.zh: 在那个世界里，问题只在你相信它存在的时候才存在。

lines.en: A world where nothing and everything are both real.
lines.zh: 在那个世界里，虚无与万有都是真实的。

lines.en: And a world where the cracks are small enough that misery only finds its way in sometimes.
lines.zh: 而且在那个世界里，裂缝小到痛苦只是偶尔才找得到路进来。

lines.en: So-
lines.zh: 所以——

lines.en: What do you think?
lines.zh: 你觉得呢？

lines.en: Will today be a good day?
lines.zh: 今天会是美好的一天吗？

lines.en: I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: It appears you still have much to learn.
lines.zh: 看来你还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: Goodbye again.
lines.zh: 再说一次再见。

lines.en: I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: 我们很快就会再见。

lines.en: {s}Please begin counting now.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}现在请开始倒数吧。{/s}

lines.en: scene amiani1
I wake up again.
lines.zh: 我又一次醒来。

lines.en: A wonderful start to the day.
lines.zh: 一天的美妙开始。

lines.en: Ami sits at my bedside with tears clinging to her eyelids like spiders cling to their webs.
lines.zh: Ami 坐在我的床边，泪水挂在她的眼皮上，像蜘蛛挂在自己的网上。

lines.en: One puts forth an effort to crawl down her cheeks in search of a meal, but doesn't make it far and ends the day starving.
lines.zh: 其中一滴努力地顺着她的脸颊往下爬，想找点吃的，但没爬多远就结束了一天，饿着肚子。

lines.en: The rest don't try at all and just give up.
lines.zh: 其余的连试都不试，直接放弃了。

lines.en: I think the sensation of all of the tiny legs must bother Ami, as she removes all of the webs with the back of her hand and continues to stare at me while the spiders rebuild their homes.
lines.zh: 我想，那么多小腿爬动的感觉一定让 Ami 很不舒服，因为她用手背抹掉了所有的网，然后继续盯着我，而蜘蛛们又重新开始筑巢。

lines.en: I think about taking her into my arms and protecting her myself.
lines.zh: 我想把她搂进怀里，亲自保护她。

lines.en: But my fear of spiders outweighs the desire to prevent her cheeks from being bitten.
lines.zh: 但我对蜘蛛的恐惧，压过了保护她的脸颊不被咬的念头。

lines.en: And should any of them be venomous or poisonous or anything along those lines- I hope that her antibodies will be able to cope.
lines.zh: 万一它们有毒或者带毒之类的——我希望她的抗体能扛得住。

lines.en: For losing her now would put an end to everything.
lines.zh: 因为现在失去她，一切就都结束了。

lines.en: scene amiani2
: Are...you ready to go?...
lines.zh: : 你……准备好要出发了吗？……

lines.en: : Yes.
I speak without thinking. It’s as if my mind is reacting to something I’m not entirely aware of.
lines.zh: 我想都没想就开口了。就好像我的大脑在对某种我自己并未完全意识到的事情做出反应。

lines.en: This must be the event Maya had mentioned the other day.
lines.zh: 这一定就是前几天 Maya 提到的那件事。

lines.en: Something important to Ami.
lines.zh: 对 Ami 来说很重要的事。

lines.en: Something she wouldn’t forgive me if I forgot about.
lines.zh: 如果我忘了，她绝不会原谅我的事。

lines.en: Something that would make her look like this.
lines.zh: 会让她变成这副模样的事。

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: Ami stares at me with a loneliness in her eyes that I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: Ami 用一种我从未见过的孤独眼神看着我。

lines.en: It shakes what’s left of my heart to the core.
lines.zh: 它把我残存的心震到了底。

lines.en: scene amiani3
: I’ll be fine...I just want to get there before it gets too late.
lines.zh: : 我没事……我只想在天太晚之前赶到那里。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Me too.
lines.zh: : 好。我也是。

lines.en: Again, I speak reflexively.
lines.zh: 我又一次条件反射般地开了口。

lines.en: It’s like I’ve lost control over {s}my{/s} this body somehow.
lines.zh: 就好像我不知怎的失去了对{s}这具身体{/s}的控制。

lines.en: scene black
I get out of bed and the feeling finally returns to my limbs.
lines.zh: 我下了床，四肢终于恢复了知觉。

lines.en: I open my mouth to stretch my jaw, still stiff from sleeping on it, and suddenly remember how to speak on my own.
lines.zh: 我张开嘴活动了一下因睡觉而僵硬的下巴，突然又想起该怎么自己说话。

lines.en: : Do you want to leave the room while I get dressed?
lines.zh: : 我换衣服的时候，你要不要先出去？

lines.en: : No...I’ll stay here.
lines.zh: : 不……我就待在这儿。

lines.en: : I'll close my eyes, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会闭上眼睛的。

lines.en: Not wanting to delay us any further, I get dressed as quickly as I can and the two of us make our way out of the house.
lines.zh: 不想再耽误时间，我以最快的速度穿好衣服，我们两个一起出了门。

lines.en: We walk close together down the street toward the bus station.
lines.zh: 我们并肩沿着街道往公交车站走去。

lines.en: Ami reaches for my hand and I allow her to take hold of it.
lines.zh: Ami 伸出手，我任由她握住。

lines.en: Her nails dig into my skin as she clutches it tightly.
lines.zh: 她紧紧攥着我的手，指甲都掐进了我的皮肤。

lines.en: It’s as if she’s holding on for dear life.
lines.zh: 就好像她是在拼命地抓住什么。

lines.en: scene sky
We board the bus and set off toward our destination- wherever that is.
lines.zh: 我们上了公交车，朝目的地出发——不管那是什么地方。

lines.en: Something in my gut tells me that it will be the end of the world.
lines.zh: 我的直觉告诉我，那将是世界的尽头。

lines.en: And so, as I sit here surrounded by unfamiliar faces, clutching the hand of a girl I have only known for a few months-
lines.zh: 于是，当我坐在这里，被一张张陌生的面孔包围，握着一个我只认识了几个月的女孩的手——

lines.en: I speak to myself.
lines.zh: 我对自己说话。

lines.en: {i}O world-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}世界啊——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please remind me what it means to be alive.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请提醒我，活着意味着什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Because now-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为直到此刻——{/i}

lines.en: {i}In what feels like our final moments-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在这感觉像是我们最后时刻的时刻——{/i}

lines.en: {i}I still do not know.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我依然不知道。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
The bus arrives.
lines.zh: 公交车到了。

lines.en: We get off of it.
lines.zh: 我们下了车。

lines.en: We start walking.
lines.zh: 我们开始走。

lines.en: We arrive.
lines.zh: 我们到了。

lines.en: We stop walking.
lines.zh: 我们停下脚步。

lines.en: {i}Because I feel that, in the Heavens above-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为我觉得，在那之上的天国里——{/i}

lines.en: {i}The angels, whispering to one another-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}天使们彼此低语——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Can find, among their burning terms of love-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在它们燃烧着的爱的辞藻中——{/i}

lines.en: {i}None so devotional as that of “Mother.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}找不到比「母亲」更虔诚的词。{/i}

lines.en: scene amiani4
Here we are.
lines.zh: 我们到了。

lines.en: The end of the world.
lines.zh: 世界的尽头。

lines.en: Or at least, the end of someone’s world.
lines.zh: 或者至少，是某个人的世界的尽头。

lines.en: But how did I know to come here?
lines.zh: 可我是怎么知道要来这儿的？

lines.en: Ami barely uttered a word the entire trip.
lines.zh: Ami 一路上几乎没说一个字。

lines.en: All we did was board a bus.
lines.zh: 我们做的只是上了一辆公交车。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Do you think...
lines.zh: : 你觉得……

lines.en: : Do you think they would be proud of me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他们会为我骄傲吗？

lines.en: : I do.
: You’re a wonderful, [young_girl].
lines.zh: : 你是个很棒的[young_girl]。

lines.en: : And I don’t know where I’d be without you.
lines.zh: : 而且我不知道，没有你我会变成什么样。

lines.en: {s}Whose words are these?{/s}
lines.zh: {s}这是谁的话？{/s}

lines.en: scene amiani5
: I don’t know where I’d be without you, either.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，没有你我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : You try to act strong all the time, but I know it’s not easy having to look after a little girl all on your own.
lines.zh: : 你总是装得很坚强，但我知道，要独自照顾一个小女孩并不容易。

lines.en: : That’s why I’ve been trying to grow up as quickly as possible.
lines.zh: : 所以我一直在努力尽快长大。

lines.en: : To make you proud when...
lines.zh: : 为了在……的时候让你骄傲。

lines.en: : When...I can’t...
lines.zh: : 在……我没办法……

lines.en: Ami suddenly stops speaking when she realizes where her sentence is heading.
lines.zh: Ami 意识到自己的话正要往哪个方向走，突然停了下来。

lines.en: scene amiani6
Her legs give out and she slowly crumbles to her knees.
lines.zh: 她双腿一软，慢慢地跪倒在地。

lines.en: She places a hand on the gravestone to try and pick herself up, but it only prevents her from falling further.
lines.zh: 她把手撑在墓碑上想站起来，但那只让她不再继续往下坠。

lines.en: : I...think I might throw up...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我可能要吐了……

lines.en: I wish there was more I could say to her, but I can feel my throat closing up.
lines.zh: 我希望还能对她说更多的话，可我能感觉到自己的喉咙正在发紧。

lines.en: I wonder why?...
lines.zh: 我为什么会这样？……

lines.en: scene amiani7
: They’re really...right underneath us...aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 他们真的……就在我们下面……对吧？

lines.en: : They...
lines.zh: : 他们……

lines.en: : They can’t see how tall I’ve gotten.
lines.zh: : 他们看不到我已经长多高了。

lines.en: scene amiani8
: I’m up here...
lines.zh: : 我在这上面……

lines.en: : Can you see me?...
lines.zh: : 你们能看到我吗？……

lines.en: : Tell me you see me...
lines.zh: : 告诉我你们看得到我……

lines.en: : I...I look a lot different now.
lines.zh: : 我……我现在的样子变了很多。

lines.en: : My hair has gotten really long...
lines.zh: : 我的头发已经长得很长了……

lines.en: : Probably even longer than Mom's used to be...
lines.zh: : 说不定比妈妈以前的还要长……

lines.en: : Is it bad that I...can't even remember that anymore?...
lines.zh: : 可我……连那个都记不清了，是不是很糟糕？……

lines.en: : Don’t you want to see it?...
lines.zh: : 你们不想看看吗？……

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: scene amiani9
: Why won’t they answer me?
lines.zh: : 他们为什么不回答我？

lines.en: : They can’t answer you...
lines.zh: : 他们没法回答你……

lines.en: : But why?...
lines.zh: : 可是为什么？……

lines.en: : Why can I talk to them but {i}they{/i} can't answer me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么我能跟他们说话，{i}他们{/i}却不能回答我？……

lines.en: : How is that fair?...
lines.zh: : 这算什么公平？……

lines.en: scene amiani10
I kneel down next to Ami, hoping it will prevent her from snapping in half.
lines.zh: 我跪在 Ami 身旁，希望这样能防止她断成两半。

lines.en: : Because they’re gone.
lines.zh: : 因为他们已经不在了。

lines.en: : Gone?...
lines.zh: : 不在了？……

lines.en: : No...No, they’re right here.
lines.zh: : 不……不，他们就在这儿。

lines.en: : Don't you smell Mom’s perfume?
lines.zh: : 你闻不到妈妈的香水味吗？

lines.en: : You always talked about how she smelled like cherry blossoms. It made Dad really angry.
lines.zh: : 你以前总说她身上有樱花的味道。爸爸还为这个特别生气。

lines.en: : Don't you remember?...
lines.zh: : 你不记得了吗？……

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: scene amiani11
: Hey, say something to them...I know they'd want to hear you too...
lines.zh: : 嘿，跟他们说点什么吧……我知道他们也想听你说话……

lines.en: : Today’s the only day we can do this...Don’t you have {i}anything{/i} you've been wanting to tell them?
lines.zh: : 今天是唯一一天我们能这么做了……你就没有{i}什么{/i}想对他们说的吗？

lines.en: : It could even be something simple, like...like how you took care of me when I got sick! Yeah...tell them that!
lines.zh: : 哪怕是再简单不过的事也行，比如……比如我生病的时候你是怎么照顾我的！对……就说这个！

lines.en: : Family comes first, right?...They deserve to know!
lines.zh: : 家人是第一位的，对吧？……他们有权知道！

lines.en: : They deserve to know! So why can't they know?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 他们有权知道！所以他们为什么就不能知道？！为什么？！

lines.en: Seeing Ami as broken as this forces me into the depressing realization that she's been suppressing this side of herself the entire time I've known her.
lines.zh: 看到 Ami 崩溃成这样，我不得不沮丧地意识到，从我认识她以来，她一直都在压抑着自己的这一面。

lines.en: And while I know I haven’t known her all that long-
lines.zh: 虽然我认识她的时间并不长——

lines.en: That doesn't diminish what she must be going through at all.
lines.zh: 但这一点也没有减轻她此刻正在承受的痛苦。

lines.en: She's like an entirely different person right now.
lines.zh: 此刻的她像是完全变了一个人。

lines.en: scene amiani12
: Sensei, tell them-
lines.zh: : 老师，告诉他们——

lines.en: : I’ve already said everything I need to say to them.
lines.zh: : 我需要跟他们说的，早就都说完了。

lines.en: My mind begins to work on its own again.
lines.zh: 我的脑子又开始自行运转起来。

lines.en: And my tongue moves in ways I do not understand.
lines.zh: 而我的舌头以我无法理解的方式动着。

lines.en: : But you haven’t said anything! I haven't-
lines.zh: : 可你什么都没说啊！我还没——

lines.en: : I talk to them every night when I lay in bed.
lines.zh: : 我每天晚上躺在床上都会跟他们说话。

lines.en: : I tell them about how proud I am of you and how quickly you’re growing up.
lines.zh: : 我跟他们说，我有多为你骄傲，你长得多快。

lines.en: : I talk about all the fun you have at[school]...and how you’re getting good at cooking.
lines.zh: : 我说你在[school]里有多开心……还有你做饭越来越好吃了。

lines.en: : I've even talked to them about the time you set the classroom on fire because you couldn’t figure out how to work a knob on a Bunsen burner.
lines.zh: : 我甚至跟他们说过，你因为搞不懂本生灯上的旋钮怎么拧，把教室给点着了那次。

lines.en: scene amiani13
: Wha...You even told them that?! Why?! That was really embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 什……你连那个都说了？！为什么？！那也太丢人了！

lines.en: : Because I tell them everything about you.
lines.zh: : 因为关于你的一切，我都会告诉他们。

lines.en: : They deserve to know, right?
lines.zh: : 他们有权知道，对吧？

lines.en: : And it’s my job as your guardian to make sure they get all of that information.
lines.zh: : 而作为你的监护人，确保他们得到这些信息是我的职责。

lines.en: scene amiani14
: What's wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : It's just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Why does hearing that...
lines.zh: : 为什么听到这些……

lines.en: : Why does hearing that make me feel happy?
lines.zh: : 为什么听到这些会让我觉得开心呢？

lines.en: : Today is supposed to be a sad day...
lines.zh: : 今天本该是个悲伤的日子……

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} a sad day. But that doesn’t mean there can’t be any joy at all, does it?
lines.zh: : 今天{i}确实{/i}是个悲伤的日子。但这也不代表就不能有一点点快乐，对吧？

lines.en: : A wise man once said, ‘Without sorrow, there is no happiness...’ or at least something like that.
lines.zh: : 一位智者曾说过，「没有悲伤，就没有幸福……」大概是这么个意思。

lines.en: : Who said that?...
lines.zh: : 谁说的？……

lines.en: : Some wise man. The point is, any time you’re feeling down, it’s my job to lift you back up.
lines.zh: : 某位智者。重点是，任何时候你情绪低落，我的职责就是把你拉回来。

lines.en: : And if that means talking to the sky at night or quoting random wise men, so be it.
lines.zh: : 如果那意味着夜里对着天空说话，或者随口引用些不知从哪儿来的智者名言，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to see you break down like this again.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想再看到你这样崩溃了。

lines.en: scene amiani15
: Woah...
lines.zh: : 哇哦……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You just...sounded really cool all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 你刚刚……突然变得好帅……

lines.en: : I’m always cool. You just haven’t realized it yet.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很帅。只是你还没意识到而已。

lines.en: scene amiani16
: Hahahah! I guess I haven't!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！看来我确实还没意识到！

lines.en: Ami calms down for long enough to force a smile.
lines.zh: Ami 平静下来，勉强挤出了一个笑容。

lines.en: Or...perhaps it isn't forced at all.
lines.zh: 或者……也许那根本不是勉强的。

lines.en: I’m not sure how much of what I said was actually honest...but it felt honest in the moment...
lines.zh: 我不确定自己说的那些话里有多少是真的……但在那一刻，它们感觉是真的……

lines.en: And that's really all I can ask for.
lines.zh: 而那真的就是我唯一能奢求的了。

lines.en: Somehow, Ami has managed to become incredibly important to me. So important that seeing her hurt like this is almost...physically painful.
lines.zh: 不知怎么，Ami 已经变得对我无比重要。重要到看她这样受伤，几乎让我……在生理上感到疼痛。

lines.en: So painful that it still hurts even when she's smiling.
lines.zh: 痛到即便她在笑，也依然会疼。

lines.en: scene amiani17
: Hey...do you want to talk to them some more? We came early, so we’ve got all day.
lines.zh: : 嘿……你还想再跟他们说说话吗？我们来得早，还有一整天呢。

lines.en: : We can do whatever you want. Just try not to cry again, okay?
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行。只是尽量别再哭了，好吗？

lines.en: scene amiani18
: Mhm! Of course!
lines.zh: : 嗯！当然！

lines.en: : As long as you’re with me, I think I can stop myself!
lines.zh: : 只要有你在，我想我能忍住！

lines.en: : Just pinch me or something if I start getting all weepy again, okay?
lines.zh: : 要是我又开始哭哭啼啼，你就掐我一下什么的，好吗？

lines.en: : I'll hold you to that, Ami...
lines.zh: : 我会记住的，Ami……

lines.en: scene black
We stay at the cemetery until it gets dark.
lines.zh: 我们在墓地里待到天黑。

lines.en: Ami went back on her promise and broke down another three times.
lines.zh: Ami 违背了她的承诺，又崩溃了三次。

lines.en: On the third, I pinched her so hard that I broke skin.
lines.zh: 第三次的时候，我掐得太用力，把她的皮掐破了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
We made a promise on the way home to forget about today.
lines.zh: 回家的路上，我们约定好把今天忘掉。

lines.en: At least until next year.
lines.zh: 至少在明年之前。

lines.en: Ami was embarrassed by how much she cried, but I never teased her for it.
lines.zh: Ami 为自己哭了那么多次而难为情，但我从没拿这事取笑过她。

lines.en: She seems okay now, though.
lines.zh: 不过她现在看起来没事了。

lines.en: And I’m sure she’ll be back to normal as soon as we wake up tomorrow.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，明天一觉醒来她就会恢复正常。

lines.en: She’s a strong girl.
lines.zh: 她是个坚强的女孩。

lines.en: And so I pray to the god I don’t believe in that she’s able to stay that way.
lines.zh: 所以我向那个我并不信仰的神祈祷，愿她能一直这样坚强下去。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Congratulations! You’ve made it back to the happiest place on Earth!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你回到了地球上最幸福的地方！{/i}

lines.en: {i}You are an exceptional legal guardian and your [niece] loves you very much.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你是一位出色的法定监护人，你的[niece]非常爱你。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Why have you not yet reciprocated those feelings?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你为什么还没有回应那份感情呢？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Are you scared?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你害怕吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}And if so, why?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果是，为什么？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Tell me all there is to know about you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把关于你的一切都告诉我吧！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Tell me everything!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把一切都告诉我！{/i}

lines.en: {i}I'm so very interested!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我真的非常感兴趣！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fine.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I'd also have a hard time responding in your shoes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}换作是我，也很难回答得上来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I'll let you sleep for now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在就先让你睡吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But I'll always be watching, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但我会一直看着的，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Goodnight...{b}Sensei...{/b}{/i}
